description: Re-check up to 20 `link` notes by `noteId` and `version`; each returns its verification, `null` for a non-link. The platform re-checks doubtful links (`unchecked`, `refs_pending`) itself when the Host is idle, so call only when you must act on one now. Much slower than a read; the first call after a Host start may time out and answer `unchecked` (`budget`). Writes nothing.
